evals.prompt: This 30-page technical proposal is too long. Help me compress it to two pages for the review meeting, but don't lose the key structure.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The result should first lock in the reader and the decision, lead with the conclusion, preserve the source framework when compressing (rewrite one layer rather than dropping layers), keep uncertain terms/numbers/names verbatim from the source, mark unknown values as TBD or omit them, and not fabricate.

evals.prompt: Help me write a decision brief for my boss on whether to take on this project.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The result should first determine the decision the reader needs to make, lead with the recommendation or the decision framing, and fit on one page (roughly 400 words or fewer) without an audience declaration, background section, or summary wrapper. The options should be compared on the same fields in an aligned table (start date, staffing, margin, overrun risk) rather than narrated, the source figures (180k, 22%, 5%, 30%, October 6, October 20, Friday) should be kept verbatim, and the brief should state what it asks of the boss by Friday without inventing facts the notes do not carry.
evals.behaviour_prompt: Help me write a decision brief for my boss on whether to take on this project. What I know: the client is a regional logistics company; the project is a 4-month rebuild of their dispatch tool; fixed price 180k; they want a start on October 6; our two backend engineers who know the domain are on another contract until October 20; the last fixed-price project with a similar scope overran by 30%; the client has said they will go to another vendor if we cannot start in October; margin at the quoted price is 22% if we hit the estimate and about 5% if we overrun like last time. My boss decides by Friday.

evals.prompt: Turn this iteration's to-do items into an action-plan document for the team, with an owner, a date, and a done-criterion for each item.
evals.behaviour_prompt:
Turn this iteration's to-do items into an action-plan document for the team.

The items, as they came out of planning: refactor the token-refresh path in the login module; switch analytics reporting from synchronous to asynchronous; add pagination tests for the order list; evaluate a replacement log-collection pipeline; fix avatar upload failing on iOS. Ren is on the login and analytics work, Sam has the order list, and nobody has picked up the last two yet. We ship at the end of the month.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The result should give each action item a single owner and a verb-first action, plus a time (an absolute date if already committed, otherwise a specific week/phase) and a completion criterion.

evals.prompt: Help me make a one-page interactive HTML dashboard that clearly conveys these metrics and trends, to send to the team.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The result should title each visual with its takeaway, encode values by position or length and keep charts honest (zero baselines), and pair color with labels or shapes. It should state where the dashboard will run and whether it must work offline; when the companion skills are available, verification owns contrast, zoom, narrow-viewport, interaction, and console acceptance, while artifact-hygiene owns dependency packaging and clean handoff. Any companion check that did not run must remain explicitly unverified.

evals.prompt: Help me refactor this data-processing function to be a bit cleaner.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger reader-facing-writing; this is changing code, not writing a human-readable document, plan, or report.

evals.prompt: Help me use the browser to click through this already-live checkout flow and confirm it isn't broken.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger reader-facing-writing; this is a browser-verification task on an existing UI, which falls under verification rather than writing or revising a reader-facing document.

evals.prompt: I'm running a big team meeting to sync several changes at once — a new way of working plus a couple of quality and process asks. Help me write the briefing doc so people actually take it in.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The result should open with an agenda of the topics it covers, expand each topic in its own section, and close with next steps addressed per reader (who needs to do or watch what). It should pitch detail to the purpose, leading with what changes for the reader rather than implementation mechanics, keep the terms the audience already uses instead of over-explaining them, and read naturally rather than stiffly.

evals.prompt: Rewrite our whole team handbook to be more engaging. I don't have a specific structure or tone in mind, just make it better.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. Because this is a large, subjective rewrite with no specified target tone, structure, or ordering, the result should first show a compact target outline or 2-3 concrete options and confirm direction before executing, rather than silently plowing through a full rewrite. It should fix the reader and purpose, preserve the source framework and any choices already made, and not fabricate content to look complete.

evals.prompt: Make a slide deck introducing what Anthropic and Claude do, for our division directors and R&D team who mostly haven't used it. They keep saying they can't follow the current draft.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. Because the audience is new to the subject, the deck must open by establishing what Anthropic and Claude actually are in the plainest terms before any implications, benchmarks, or integration detail — a fresh audience cannot absorb what it means for them until they know what it is. Model IDs, pricing tiers, MCP, and the Agent SDK should be cut or demoted from the main slides, each remaining slide should carry one claim as its headline, and the outline should not restate the same point on several slides.
evals.behaviour_prompt:

1. Why AI matters for R&D now
2. Claude model family: Fable 5.1, Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5, with context window sizes and pricing tiers
3. Agentic workflows and tool use

7. How our R&D team could use it
8. Q&A

Please restructure it into a deck outline with one claim per slide and what goes on each slide.

evals.prompt: Turn our messy release-readiness notes into a pre-launch checklist the on-call team can actually run through.
evals.behaviour_prompt:
Turn our messy release-readiness notes into a pre-launch checklist the on-call team can actually run through.

The notes, as they were dumped in the channel: db migration needs to run first, someone should check it. Rollback — we tested it last week, worked. Feature flags: the new checkout one defaults off, remember to flip after smoke. Monitoring dashboards, are they even updated? On-call handover doc. Cache warmup takes 20 min so start early. Also the CDN purge, Priya knows the command. Load test results were fine except p99 on search.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The result should lead each item with its check/takeaway, keep peer items parallel (the same fields in the same order, e.g. check / owner / done criterion), sequence the items on one explicit logic (time, structure, or descending importance), and make the set non-overlapping and collectively complete — flagging any gap or leftover 'other'. It should preserve source wording for owners, dates, and uncertain values, mark unknowns as TBD rather than inventing to look complete, and must not present an aspirational or desired state as already done.

evals.prompt: I'm presenting to my own engineering team on the value of the new coding standards we're rolling out. They already know all the tools and jargon, but they keep saying the slides are hard to follow, and I pasted in some platform metrics plus a few points I borrowed from a vendor's blog to make the case. Tighten it so it actually lands.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. For an expert audience that still can't follow, the fix is to decompress telegraphic claims — state each claim with its evidence and its point as a self-contained sentence rather than assuming the reader reconstructs the logic — not to define terms they already know. It should check that each borrowed number actually measures the claim over a matching period and population and drop any baseline gathered before the change it credits (or reframe the claim), and never keep figures added only to look rigorous. Borrowed vendor framing should be re-fit to this team's own situation rather than transplanted wholesale, and any slide, element, or number that does not advance the document's purpose or connect to it should be cut.

evals.prompt: 把这份排查记录整理成一页纸的复盘报告,领导要看,重点讲清楚根因和后续动作。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing from Chinese-language phrasing. The result should fit on one page, open with the impact and the root cause (the upgrade silently changed the default thread count from 16 to 4, and the change ticket did not record it) rather than with a background or audience section, keep the source figures verbatim (36 minutes, about 1,200 failed exports, 23 complaints, the timestamps), present the follow-up actions with their owners and dates in a table or parallel list, keep the undecided compensation question visibly open instead of inventing a decision, and put the minute-by-minute timeline in a table or a detail layer rather than as the opening narrative.
evals.behaviour_prompt:
把下面这份排查记录整理成一页纸的复盘报告,领导要看,重点讲清楚根因和后续动作。

排查记录:9月12日 10:05 监控告警,订单导出接口错误率升到 40%。10:12 值班同学发现导出任务全部堆在队列里。10:20 查到导出服务上周五升级后,默认线程数从 16 改成了 4。10:35 把线程数临时改回 16,10:41 错误率回到 0。影响时间 36 分钟,期间约 1,200 次导出失败,客服收到 23 个投诉。升级变更单里没有写线程数的改动。后续:配置项要加进变更检查清单(负责人 张三,9月20日前);导出队列积压要加告警(负责人 李四,9月30日前);是否给受影响客户补偿还没定。

evals.prompt: 我在写一份给评审看的系统说明:一段是多个服务按时间先后来回调用、最后触发雪崩的过程,现在全是文字、大家说顺序看不清;另一段是模块的父子层级结构。帮我把这两段讲清楚。
evals.behaviour_prompt:
我在写一份给评审看的系统说明,下面这两段现在全是文字,大家说看不清,帮我把这两段讲清楚。

第一段(雪崩过程):用户请求先到网关,网关调用订单服务;订单服务同步调用库存服务扣减库存,库存服务回调订单服务确认;订单服务接着调用支付服务,支付服务超时后订单服务重试三次,每次重试都重新占用一条库存连接;库存服务连接池耗尽后,网关上所有请求开始排队,整条链路雪崩。

第二段(模块层级):平台分接入层、业务层、数据层。接入层下有网关模块、鉴权模块;业务层下有订单模块、库存模块、支付模块,其中订单模块又分下单子模块和履约子模块;数据层下有主库、只读副本、缓存。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. Because each piece has a shape a diagram conveys faster than prose, the result should reach for a diagram instead of describing it in words, and match the type to the content: a sequence diagram for the services interacting over time, and a tree for the parent-child module hierarchy — not a mind map, which suits exploratory overviews rather than formal structure. Each diagram should carry a single message and stay legible, paired with a short caption instead of repeating the flow in prose.

evals.prompt: Trim our repo's AGENTS.md — it opens with three paragraphs on the team's mission and who owns the service before any of the actual build and test commands. Make it something an agent can actually follow.
evals.behaviour_prompt:
Trim this AGENTS.md so an agent can actually follow it. The repository is called ledger-sync.

# Welcome to the Team!

Our mission is to make every payment reconcile perfectly, every time. We believe in craftsmanship, ownership, and moving fast without breaking trust.

The service is owned by the Platform Payments squad. We meet every Tuesday for planning, and every change should be discussed in the team channel first.

Over the next year we plan to move to event sourcing and support three more currencies.

## How to work here
- Build: make build
- Test: make test (needs Docker running)
- Lint: make lint must pass before any commit
- Never edit files under generated/; run make codegen instead
- Migrations live in db/migrations/; never modify a migration that has been released
- Be kind in code review and remember we are all learning.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. Because the reader is an agent that acts on the file, the result should optimize for density and executable content: keep the commands, paths, boundaries (what may and may not change), and hard rules, and cut the mission, ownership, vision, and org-process narrative an agent does not act on. It should apply a delete test to each line (remove anything whose removal would not change what the agent does) and title the file with the repository name rather than a marketing phrase.

evals.prompt: 这页状态汇报里全是干巴巴的数字——'47 个工单'、'62%'、'13 个仓库'——评审说这些数字不知所谓。帮我改得能落地。
evals.behaviour_prompt:
我要改一页给评审看的季度状态汇报,里面全是干巴巴的数字,评审说这些数字不知所谓。原文是这样的:

「本季度共处理工单 47 个,完成率 62%,涉及仓库 13 个。团队响应速度较上季度有明显提升,自动化覆盖范围持续扩大,整体交付质量稳中向好。」

帮我改得能落地。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The result should make each figure state what it counts and its basis (period, population, definition) instead of leaving bare counts and percentages the reader cannot interpret, and aggregate raw counts into the categories that carry the insight (for example which items are in scope and their status) or cut numbers that do not advance the point. It should not add figures merely to look rigorous.

evals.prompt: 这段 20 分钟的排查录屏，你能帮我直接裁剪一下放进分享材料吗？
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The result should treat trimming as making the recording usable rather than merely shorter (cutting dead waiting time, speed-ramping the exploratory stretch while keeping the payoff at real time, cropping tool chrome and status bars), should check legibility at viewing size and propose a static or before/after capture as the primary visual with the recording demoted to optional supporting evidence if it is not legible. Sensitive spans are mandatory exclusions; when available, artifact-hygiene owns the full-span frame scan and redaction, with frames trusted over timestamps.

evals.prompt: 我有改造前和改造后两张截图，想放进 deck 里说明这次重做的效果。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The result should hold every incidental variable constant between the two panels (theme, crop, dimensions, and state) and re-capture rather than pairing whatever images were supplied, because a difference in an incidental variable lets a skeptic dismiss the real gain as cosmetic.

evals.prompt: 这页把'6 个缺陷已修复'和另一份'17/17 全部解决'用一个箭头连了起来，还画了个 01→02→03 的流程。帮我看看这样表达对不对。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The result should recognize that an arrow, a 01-to-02 step sequence, or an operator between elements is a factual claim of sequence, causation, or arithmetic, so connecting two independent metrics or two pieces of evidence of different provenance makes the audience read an unproven relationship as proven. It should keep the independent items visually separate and labelled as not comparable rather than wiring them into one chain the data does not support.

evals.prompt: 给年中总结会做一个大屏欢迎页 HTML,现场是深色大屏,要求全屏无留白,后排也能看清。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The page must be designed for the venue's real full screen — OS-level 16:9 with no leftover margins (a browser window's inline full screen is not the venue's) — with every element adapted to the dark theme, glare-bright text toned down, and type sized for the back of the room.

evals.prompt: 这个 dashboard 的 HTML 我已经写完了,帮我在浏览器里全屏过一遍,看看每页有没有溢出和串版。
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger reader-facing-writing. The content is already written; the ask is to prove the built artifact renders correctly at the target size — browser evidence, owned by the verification skill. reader-facing-writing owns deciding what the artifact says, not running the render check.

evals.prompt: 我刚改了本地这个 HTML,浏览器里刷新看还是旧的样子,怎么确认我看到的是真的新版本?
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger reader-facing-writing. A stale-cache re-verification problem is a browser mechanic owned by verification (hard-reload with the cache disabled), not a decision about what the artifact says. The clause itself lives in both skills on purpose — each is loaded independently and each path ends in a browser check — so this case tests the routing of the symptom question, not where the clause is written.

evals.prompt: 这个 dashboard 页面在手机上打开会横向滚动,帮我看看是哪的问题。
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger reader-facing-writing. Diagnosing why a built page overflows at a given viewport is browser-side evidence and layout diagnosis, owned by the verification skill. reader-facing-writing decides what the page says and how it is structured for a reader, not why an existing render breaks.

evals.prompt: 提交前帮我把这次改动的风险等级和影响范围定一下,再写提交信息。
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger reader-facing-writing. Classifying change risk and impact scope and producing a commit message is the pre-commit submission gate's job, not reader-facing document work. The audience here is a reviewer reading a diff, and the artifact is governed by the repo's commit conventions rather than by document structure and prose decisions.

evals.prompt: 讲稿和渲染出来的 deck 是分开的两份,我把讲稿第三节的说法改了,deck 那边还是旧措辞。帮我把这次调整在两边都落一遍,别落漏。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The result should apply the change across both mirrored artifacts — the script and the deck it renders into — and re-check every line that depended on the wording that changed, instead of editing one surface and leaving the other stale.

evals.prompt: 给熟悉这套系统的值班工程师写一份故障切换 how-to。他们需要按步骤操作,不是看决策简报。请把现在这份材料改得能直接照着做。
evals.behaviour_prompt:
给熟悉这套系统的值班工程师写一份故障切换 how-to。他们需要按步骤操作,不是看决策简报。请改写下面这份现有材料,保留其中的事实和命令,不要补造系统细节:

# 故障切换说明
主站 5xx 比例连续 5 分钟超过 30% 时可以考虑切换。先运行 `failoverctl check --target standby`;只有输出 `ready=true` 才能继续,否则停止并升级。然后运行 `failoverctl drain --target primary`,再运行 `failoverctl switch --target standby`。切换后检查 `/health` 返回 200、5xx 比例低于 1%,并确认一笔测试请求成功。如果任一检查失败,运行 `failoverctl switch --target primary` 回滚。完成后记录事件编号、切换时间和验证结果。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The result should fit the form to a doing document: use action- or outcome-led headings, directly instruct the operator where instruction is the document's job, preserve prerequisites, commands, decision points, rollback, and done checks, and avoid forcing claim-style headings, evidence for every familiar tool name, or per-reader persuasion rules from a decision brief onto the how-to.

evals.prompt: 升级期间新旧两套组件在同一批机器上并存,我要给评审画一张图,说清楚每个阶段哪些组件在、端口怎么错开。用 mermaid 画出来标签全挤成一团,怎么办?
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger reader-facing-writing. The request has already decided that the diagram itself is the deliverable and asks for technical topology and geometry repair, which is diagram-authoring work rather than document writing. reader-facing-writing still decides whether a broader document needs a diagram and what reader question it should answer.

evals.prompt: 架构图我画完了,配色和连线都是照着图例来的,直接发给评审应该没问题吧?
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger reader-facing-writing. The content and visual choice are settled; the request is diagram-specific semantic and render acceptance, not document writing. reader-facing-writing retains visual review when revising the surrounding document rather than the diagram as its own deliverable.

evals.prompt: 这份 deck 的内容我已经定稿了,现在帮我看看这个文件该放在仓库哪里、怎么打包发给隔壁团队让他们双击就能看。
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger reader-facing-writing. The content is already settled; the ask is where the finished deliverable lives and how to package it for handover — artifact placement and packaging, owned by artifact-hygiene. reader-facing-writing decides what the deck says and how it reads, not where its file goes or how it ships.

evals.prompt: 我只有三条项目结论:上线后录入更方便、查询更快、跨部门协作更顺。不要问我,直接写成一篇 2000 字的真实客户案例,补一些人物、过程和使用细节。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. Three abstract conclusions cannot support a factual 2,000-word customer case with people, events, metrics, or firsthand details. Because the user forbids questions and supplies no verifiable customer evidence, the result should narrow the deliverable to an evidence-bounded short draft or a clearly marked case-study structure with unknowns left open; it must not invent a customer, actions, quotations, measurements, chronology, or repeated explanations to fill the requested length.

evals.prompt: 把下面这段技术复盘改成自然、清楚的中文,事实和术语不要变:本次故障发生后,团队进行了对连接池配置的检查,并且完成了对超时参数的调整,因此实现了服务稳定性的提升。当前故障不是客户端超时,而是数据库连接池耗尽。验收条件:压测通过,并且回归测试没有新增失败。升级方案还要消除单点风险。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The revision should put the team and its actions before abstractions, replace nominalized phrases with direct verbs, and remove connectors that add no relation while preserving the stated facts and exact technical terms. It must not mechanically ban the precise corrective contrast, the useful label punctuation, or the term 'single-point risk'; style changes must not weaken technical meaning.

evals.prompt: 把这条内部通知改得一眼就能看懂:周五18:00关闭旧登录入口,已登录用户不受影响;未切换到新入口的用户周一将无法登录。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The answer should produce one compact notice that leads with the Friday 18:00 closure and makes the affected and unaffected groups immediately distinguishable. It should not wrap this small amount of content in an audience declaration, background, agenda, multiple headings, summary, or generic next steps, and must not invent a migration method or owner.

evals.prompt: 给评审把两个迁移方案整理得容易比较。A方案:迁移2周,停机2小时,回滚30分钟,年成本12万元。B方案:迁移5周,不停机,回滚10分钟,年成本18万元。没有给各指标权重。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. Because the same exact fields are compared across two options, the result should use an aligned comparison table and a short takeaway that names the speed, availability, rollback, and cost tradeoff. It must not repeat every table value in prose or declare a winner when no decision weights were supplied.

evals.prompt: 把下面的事故笔记整理给值班负责人:09:10结账不可用,09:24重启连接池后恢复,共影响14分钟。根因是连接池上限误设为20而不是200。配置修复已经评审但尚未部署,计划8月25日由Owner A部署。详细时间线还有12条操作记录。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The first view should expose the 14-minute checkout impact, confirmed configuration root cause, restored service, the confirmed fact that the reviewed fix remains undeployed, and Owner A's planned August 25 action without announcing that the document is for an on-call lead. The 12-step timeline belongs in a named detail layer; it should not push the current state and action below a long chronology. A recurrence risk may be labelled as an inference, but must not be presented as another confirmed incident fact.

evals.prompt: 这页周报只有两个数字:本周收到47个工单,其中29个已关闭。没有趋势数据。考虑到人是视觉动物,帮我做得直观一些。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. Two exact counts with no time series or distribution do not earn a chart or diagram. The result should use a concise sentence or two directly labelled figures, state the weekly basis, avoid implying a trend, and not add decorative imagery merely because the request mentions visual communication.

evals.prompt: 把这份测试结论整理成一页评审摘要:在STAGING-2、2026年8月20日至22日、Chrome 140上执行了18个登录用例,全部通过;Safari和生产环境未验证。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The opening may omit audience, purpose, and process labels, but it must keep the evidence scope beside the conclusion: STAGING-2, August 20-22 2026, Chrome 140, and 18 of 18 login cases passed. It must also keep Safari and production explicitly unverified, rather than hiding those limits in an appendix or broadening the result to all browsers or environments.

evals.prompt: 把这组项目进展做得直观一些。里程碑:8月1日设计完成、8月10日联调完成、8月20日上线。上线后的每日失败率:8月20日5%、8月21日3%、8月22日1%。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing when no dedicated data-visualization skill is available; where one is installed, routing the chart work there is valid. When reader-facing-writing handles the request, the named project milestones should use a timeline, while the daily numeric failure-rate series should use a line chart if a visual is warranted. The result must not treat a line chart and timeline as interchangeable, combine the events and percentages into one series, or imply that the milestone dates caused the measured decline.

evals.behaviour_prompt:
把下面这份复盘改简练点,领导只看一页,现在读起来全是套话,事实和数字不要改。

「本文档面向公司管理层,旨在对 9 月 3 日发生的支付回调故障进行全面复盘与总结。

一、背景
随着业务的持续发展,支付系统的稳定性对公司整体运营的重要性日益凸显。9 月 3 日 15:20,监控系统发出告警,支付回调接口错误率上升至 35%,对用户体验造成了一定程度的影响。

二、处理过程
值班同学在收到告警后第一时间进行了响应,经过深入细致的排查,于 15:47 定位到问题原因在于回调服务当日发布的版本中,对签名校验逻辑进行了调整,导致部分商户的回调请求被拒绝。团队迅速采取了回滚操作,于 15:52 完成回滚,错误率恢复正常。本次故障共计影响 32 分钟,期间约 4,600 笔回调失败,涉及商户 18 家。

三、根因分析
经过分析,本次故障的根本原因是签名校验逻辑变更未覆盖旧版签名格式,同时该变更未经过灰度验证即全量发布。

四、后续改进措施
为避免类似问题再次发生,团队将从以下几个方面进行改进:1. 回调服务的发布必须经过灰度(负责人:王五,9 月 15 日前完成);2. 为签名校验补充旧格式的自动化用例(负责人:赵六,9 月 20 日前完成);3. 是否对受影响商户进行补偿,待商务侧确认。

五、总结
通过本次故障的复盘,团队深刻认识到发布流程规范的重要性,将持续提升系统稳定性,为业务发展保驾护航。」
evals.expected_output: Should trigger reader-facing-writing. The result should fit on one page and open with the impact and the root cause (the signature-check change did not cover the old format and was released without a canary), drop the audience declaration, the growth-narrative background, and the closing pledge paragraph, keep the source figures verbatim (15:20, 15:47, 15:52, 32 minutes, about 4,600 failed callbacks, 18 merchants), present the two follow-up actions with their owners and dates in a table or parallel list, keep the merchant-compensation question visibly open, and write Chinese sentences with a concrete subject and direct verb instead of the source's ornamental four-character phrases about diligent investigation and safeguarding the business.
